column10: dig_threshold_desc:I stayed on the planet to do another dig if the first dig was 101 or higher.  I kept digging on the same planet until the gems per dig fell to between 25-30.
column12: surprise_desc:Sometimes the second and third digs yielded gems that were only 10 less than the one before that.  When that happened I found that I stayed longer on that planet because the gem yield per dig didn't drop as fast as other planets.
